name: mikrotik-config-builder
description: Full-stack web application for generating MikroTik RouterOS scripts

scripts.dev: npm run install:deps && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail=false "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:deps: cd server && npm install --prefer-offline --silent && cd ../client && npm install --prefer-offline --silent
scripts.build: cd server && npm install --omit=dev && cd ../client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build:client
